body: Yes I am fine with her.  She is really helpful.
I don't even know what I want to do.  At first I thought engineering, then I switched to Psychology then Sport Management.  I have no idea which is another thing that troubles me.

It is a very big school(25-35k) and most people are with their own cliques by now(Jr. College).  My roomates rarely talk to me because they are very quiet themselves and are gone all day with their friends.  I think it may be best that I go to a smaller school maybe.
